fit_scope: Only sampled calibration grades from disjoint queries enter fitted parameters. No model selection on evaluation outcomes.
grade_label_cost: One purchased judgment returns its original relevance grade. Binary baselines receive its binary mapping. Additional time needed for graded annotation is not modeled.
scope: Exploratory generative modeling on already inspected benchmarks. Qwen supplies binary scores with graded gold labels. Released Flan-UL2 supplies genuine graded probability vectors. No new LLM inference.
